# Copilot Instructions for L’Artisan Indien

Use these repository-specific rules when working in this project:

- Follow `/CONTRIBUTING.md` for setup and contribution workflow.
- Use the PR checklist format from `/.github/pull_request_template.md`.
- Reuse marketplace seed data from `/lib/data.ts` instead of duplicating product, category, or artisan fixtures.
- Prefer existing TypeScript and React patterns already present in `/app`, `/components`, and `/lib`.
- Before finalizing changes, run `npm run lint`.
